acceptanceCriteria: `corvint-cem-anchor/1` pointers carry base, patchSha256 and targetTree; `pointerState` recomputes base..REV and returns `scope-mismatch` when the map does not describe REV; `/0` pointers stay readable.
`cem provenance --notes-tip OID` reports `rollback` when OID is not an ancestor of the live refs/notes/corvint tip.
Tests: anchoring map(A) onto a sibling commit yields scope-mismatch; resetting the notes ref yields rollback; `verified` implies the anchored patch equals base..REV.
body: Source: decision 0523 (docs/decisions/0523-cem-1-0-rc3-verifier-computed-support-2026-10-11.md) and build-log docs/build-log/2026-10-11-cem-1-0-expert-panel.md, origin/main fb11b2274. Repro: `cem anchor --map M --commit REV` where M is HEAD's map and REV is a sibling commit with the same parent; `cem provenance` reports `verified`. internal/gitnotes/anchor.go attaches HEAD's committed pointer to any REV; provenance.go `pointerState` checks path, blob and digest only. Second repro: reset refs/notes/corvint to its parent; the anchor is reported absent, not rolled back. Proposed CEM-V1-067 (pointer `corvint-cem-anchor/1` with base, patchSha256, targetTree; `scope-mismatch`; `--notes-tip` with `rollback`). Both paths also refuse cem/1.0 because they call wire.ParseMap (see the cem/v2 statement ticket). Version: 1.0.0-rc.3 build 407.
title: cem anchor/provenance: a pointer is `verified` for any commit it was attached to, and a reset notes ref reads as absent rather than rolled back
